what: Cusick drape of published woven fabrics: KES-FB inputs and the measured drape coefficient of the same fabric
source: S. Petrak, M. Mahnic Naglic, D. Rogale, J. Gersak, 'Analysis of Polygonal Computer Model Parameters and Influence on Fabric Drape Simulation', Materials 2021, 14(21), 6259, doi:10.3390/ma14216259 (CC BY)
source_notes: Mechanics (Table 2, KES-FB part, p. 6): EM at Fm = 490.35 cN per unit width; B warp (-1) and weft (-2); one shear rigidity G per fabric; T0 at 0.49 cN cm-2.
Units as printed: B 'cNcm' read as the KES unit cN cm^2/cm (1e-4 N m); G 'cN/(cm°)-1' read as cN/(cm deg) (the paper's FAST G agrees: F1 23 N/m vs 23.5 here).
Drape (section 2.3, p. 6): Cusick drape meter, 30 cm samples, horizontal disk radius 90 mm, 5 samples per fabric, Kd = (A - pi R1^2) / (pi (R2^2 - R1^2)). Node counts not reported.
Picked: no elastane, KES B not flagged (the team, notes/wp2-fabric/sources.md).

rig.clamped: between two discs of the support diameter
rig.dc: (A_shadow - A_support) / (A_specimen - A_support), shadow seen from above

conversions.G: cN/(cm deg) x 57.30 = N/m per rad
